summary.en: Kogoro and Shiratori are invited somewhere in the mountains of Tokyo as guests to a wine appreciation party hosted by Murozo Honjo, a wine collector, in order to celebrate the 70th birthday of Shinya Hirose, a famous wine critic. While exploring the villa, Ran and Conan notice Honjo in an argument with Goro Akamaru, a wine critic. From afar, Conan witnesses Honjo smashing a brick into Akamaru's skull.
